verdict.rationale: Edge0 ships a repo script for downloading model tiers from the command line (`scripts/fetch_models.py --tier edge0-35b --target-dir models`), where a single download yields a ready-to-run bundle. It also has an `edge0` CLI for serving and running models, with flags to toggle adapters. However, downloading goes through a Python helper script rather than the CLI itself. No model search or listing is evidenced, and management is limited to swapping adapter files and runtime flags. missing for 10: CLI model search/discovery, integrated download command in the edge0 CLI, list/remove/update model management commands, independent hands-on corroboration.
